prompts.name: environment-1
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background asset for TURNTALE, an atmospheric fantasy tile game. Cinematic high-end game environment with believable stone, weathered wood, fine material grain, atmospheric depth, physically plausible shadows, warm practical lamps balanced with cool moonlight. Rich painterly realism, not flat vector, not low-poly, not plastic. Wide landscape composition. Eye-height view into the location, horizon around the upper third. Foreground lower 60 percent is a quiet, empty floor/ground to allow a separate 3D playing surface to be composited. NO central table, no tiles, no characters, no text, no UI, no watermark, no dramatic lens flare. Keep subtle detail at edges and distant focus. Ancient starlight gateway on a floating island. Old limestone arch framing distant layered cloud seas and stars. Moss in worn steps, two small amber lanterns, roots and ferns on stone edges. Midnight teal and old gold. Foreground is worn limestone courtyard.

prompts.name: ivory-material
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Production PBR-style albedo material texture. Entire square frame is a close orthographic macro photograph of warm ivory-colored polished cast resin used for premium physical game tiles. Barely visible fine pores, extremely subtle organic mottling and hairline wear, soft milky off-white cream, realistic tactile surface, very restrained low contrast, uniformly lit diffuse neutral light, no directional shadow. Material fills every edge with no object silhouette, no border, no text, no number, no symbol, no logo, no table, no collage. Not marble, no strong veins, no yellow stains. A single uninterrupted texture.

prompts.name: stone-material
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Production PBR-style albedo texture, one uninterrupted square photograph of aged fine-grained grey limestone/slate. Orthographic top-down macro, diffuse neutral even light, natural mineral grains and tiny worn pits, sparse subtle hairline stone seams, moderately low contrast. Entire frame filled edge to edge by a single stone material, no outer slab edge, no perspective, no horizon, no objects, no table, no text, no symbols, no collage. Believable tactile detail for a fantasy stone gaming plinth. No large dramatic cracks and no moss obscuring the surface.
